gs.show_room_tooltip: Show the room information window on hover
support.attach_hint: Includes anonymized plan geometry, settings and links, diagnostic statuses and a limited sample of the robot path. No original names or Home Assistant IDs, arbitrary sensor readings, URLs, images or presence history.
support.attach_legacy: Attach anonymized information from your plan
support.attach_hint_legacy: Includes allowed plan geometry, settings and browser facts, but no live device or robot-path diagnostics.
support.legacy_diagnostics: Limited diagnostics — update the integration for an extended report.
support.diag.revision_mismatch: The plan has changed or has unsaved edits
support.diag.access_denied: Some sources cannot be read with your permissions
support.diag.unknown_reference: Some references could not be verified
support.diag.unsupported_version: A data version is not supported
support.diag.resource_unobserved: Some image load states were not observed
support.geometry_warning: The package contains no names or Home Assistant IDs, but it does contain the exact geometry and dimensions of your home.
support.close_busy_body: House Plan is preparing or sending the report. Closing now stops waiting for the result.
support.privacy: When you send, your message, optional contact and, if selected, exact geometry leave your Home Assistant through the House Plan project relay and are visible to maintainers. The project node keeps the report for up to 30 days. Network infrastructure sees your HA server address, but House Plan does not retain it raw; rate-limit and idempotency metadata is kept for up to 24 hours.
support.manual_recovery: You can keep the message and attachment and continue manually:
support.success: Report sent: {id}. Save this number when contacting support.
support.update_required: Update the House Plan card and integration to compatible versions to send reports.
support.copy_failed: Could not access the clipboard. Select and copy the text manually.
support.validation.message_too_long: The message must contain no more than 10,000 characters.
support.validation.contact_too_long: Contact details must contain no more than 320 characters.
support.validation.preview_missing: Wait for the attachment preview or turn the attachment off.
support.validation.preview_expired: The attachment preview expired. Refresh the snapshot.
support.error.support_invalid_message: Check the message and try again.
support.error.support_preview_expired: The attachment preview expired or is no longer available. Refresh the snapshot.
support.error.support_package_too_large: The anonymized package exceeds the 8 MiB limit.
support.error.support_rate_limited: Too many reports or previews were requested. Try again later.
support.error.support_unavailable: The private support service is temporarily unavailable. Your draft remains here.
support.error.support_rejected: The report did not pass the support service validation.
support.error.unauthorized: You do not have permission to send this report.
vac.routes_state_unmapped: current map is not assigned to a floor
vac.routes_state_ambiguous: two maps are indistinguishable — no floor is chosen
vac.routes_empty: No map is assigned to a floor yet.
vac.route_delete_title: Remove the map from its floor?
vac.route_delete_body: Calibration and saved paths for this map will be removed. Continue?
vac.route_space_title: Move the map to another space?
vac.route_space_body: Calibration and saved paths for this map will be removed. Continue?
vac.route_missing_space_hint: One of the maps points at a deleted space: pick a new one or remove the map. Until then the robot is not drawn for that map.
vac.route_default_hint: The source reports no stable map id. Several floors cannot be told apart without another source or the robot's own selected map.
vac.route_target_hint: The dock stays in the “{space}” space regardless of the current map.
vac.route_add_source_hint: If the integration creates a separate camera for each map, choose the camera below.
